33132e345892ca02d0aa67e27c19234736cc542e.sourceText: 所以，做已有地图导航时，这份YAML中的mode仍写mapping，也不代表slam_toolbox在后台继续建图，因为该节点根本没有启动。若以后要使用slam_toolbox自己的定位方案，需要相应定位节点、序列化地图和匹配流程；那是另一套启动需求。[官方定位节点实现](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/src/slam_toolbox_localization.cpp)
33132e345892ca02d0aa67e27c19234736cc542e.translatedText: Therefore, when performing navigation on an existing map, even if the mode in this YAML is still set to mapping, it does not mean that slam_toolbox continues to build the map in the background, because that node is not started at all\. If slam_toolbox's own localization solution is to be used in the future, the corresponding localization node, serialized map, and matching process are required; that is a separate startup requirement\.[Official localization node implementation](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/src/slam_toolbox_localization.cpp)

33151bfda93fd50ca830f42bd64a3d133475f1a5.sourceText: 当前81越大，条件越严格。代码允许的距离误差还随点到雷达的距离变化，例如1 m处约11.1 cm、4 m处约22.2 cm；这些是匹配门槛，不是定位精度或车必须离墙多远。
33151bfda93fd50ca830f42bd64a3d133475f1a5.translatedText: The larger the current 81, the stricter the condition\. The distance error allowed by the code also varies with the distance from the point to the radar, for example about 11\.1 cm at 1 m and about 22\.2 cm at 4 m; these are matching thresholds, not positioning accuracy or how far the vehicle must stay from the wall\.
